proposal.summary: Reflected/stored cross-site scripting (XSS) in General Solutions Steiner GmbH CASE 3 Taskmanagement v3.3 via the fieldname parameter allowing execution of arbitrary web scripts or HTML.
proposal.affected_product: General Solutions Steiner GmbH CASE 3 Taskmanagement v3.3
proposal.cwe_quote: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in General Solutions Steiner GmbH CASE 3 Taskmanagement V 3.3 allows attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload injected into the fieldname parameter.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm whether the fieldname parameter is reflected or stored, reproduce the XSS with a benign script, and determine whether authentication is required; then implement proper output encoding/escaping and input validation on that parameter.
